mask_review: For any power-of-two page_size > 0, addr % page_size != 0 equals addr & (page_size - 1) != 0 over the full uint64 address domain, including UINT64_MAX.
Add platform_assert(IS_POWER_OF_2(io_cfg->page_size)) before __builtin_clzll in clockcache_config_init. This makes the already-required shift invariant explicit and prevents zero-input UB.

Production io geometry validation accepts only 4096-byte pages and runs before clockcache configuration; internal tests also use power-of-two inputs. Nonpower or zero direct internal configuration was already invalid; early assertion is a stronger failure mode.

No production assignment changes io_cfg.page_size after initialization in the inspected source. Pointer mutability remains an implicit configuration contract already required by stored log_page_size, page_capacity, allocation masks and buffers.
Retain lookup capacity checking and allocator_page_valid on misses unchanged. A zero address remains aligned but is correctly rejected as an unallocated extent by allocator_page_valid on miss.
No new page-size field or copy needed. Derive page_size - 1 from the existing io configuration at use site.
codegen_findings: main/original/outlined clockcache_try_get_read.constprop.0 normal path is instruction-identical modulo addresses and cold diagnostic line numbers.
main/original/outlined clockcache_unget normal path is instruction-identical modulo addresses and cold diagnostic line numbers.

Outlined synchronous clockcache_get stack frame grows from 0x38 to 0x48 bytes; blocking argument reload shifts to stack; prelookup log_page_size load moves before divide. These are real codegen differences but do not prove the observed short-run 15-20 percent slowdown.

Every current main/original/outlined synchronous resident hit executes uint64 integer division for addr % page_size, despite power-of-two geometry. Mask removes that division without relaxing validation.

Original asynchronous get outer frame adds three saved registers relative to main; membership validation is inlined in the outer coroutine despite never running on hits. Outlining allocator membership can remove this codegen pollution but must be justified by timings, not just symbol sizes.
